pairs.why: A's bell and long, thick, ruffled oral arms trailing diagonally with a few thin tentacles match the real jellyfish's flowing form better than B's compact, centered frill.
B's body is flatter with tighter corners and separate = and + keys, while A is a puffy pillow with soft blob corners and a wide 0 key that the real card doesn't have.
A's few thick, blunt, sausage-like branches match the chunky real coral, while B's branches are thinner and more numerous.
A's plump round body and large round head are closer to the real fat duck, while B is slimmer with a long tail.
A has a thick rim and heavy bold hands and ticks like the real clock, while B is thinner.
A has a thick slab top, a chunky pedestal and short wide stools like the real table, while B has a thin top and tall narrow pedestal and stools.
A's thick rim and bold hands and ticks are proportioned like the real clock, while B has a thinner rim and smaller parts.
A has fewer, thicker, blunt-tipped branches like the real coral, while B has thinner, more numerous branches.
